# `aitbc explorer block-by-hash`

Get a block by its hash on the specified chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer block-by-hash [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--block-hash` | text | — | yes | The Block hash. |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer block-by-hash --block-hash <block_hash>
```
